import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long n, k, modVal;
    static int[] fact = new int[262155];
    static int[] invFact = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[262155][31];
    static int[] bitCount = new int[262155];
    static int[] twoPowerCount = new int[262155];
    static List<int[]> orderList = new ArrayList<>();

    static void readInt(DataInputStream in, int[] buffer) throws IOException {
        int ch;
        buffer[0] = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        while ((ch = in.read()) != -1 && !Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') neg = true;
        }
        if (ch == -1) return;
        do {
            buffer[0] = (buffer[0] << 3) + (buffer[0] << 1) + (ch ^ '0');
        } while ((ch = in.read()) != -1 && Character.isDigit(ch));
        if (neg) buffer[0] = -buffer[0];
    }

    static void readLL(DataInputStream in, long[] buffer) throws IOException {
        int ch;
        buffer[0] = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        while ((ch = in.read()) != -1 && !Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') neg = true;
        }
        if (ch == -1) return;
        do {
            buffer[0] = (buffer[0] << 3) + (buffer[0] << 1) + (ch ^ '0');
        } while ((ch = in.read()) != -1 && Character.isDigit(ch));
        if (neg) buffer[0] = -buffer[0];
    }

    static int modPow(int base, long exp) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) (((long) result * base) % modVal);
            }
            base = (int) (((long) base * base) % modVal);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int countTrailingZeros(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0 && (x & 1) == 0) {
            ++cnt;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int binomial(int n, int m) {
        return (int) (((long) fact[n] * invFact[m]) % modVal * invFact[n - m] % modVal);
    }

    static int iterativeSolve(int startN, int startK) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{startN, startK});
        orderList.clear();
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curN = cur[0], curK = cur[1];
            orderList.add(new int[]{curN, curK});
            
            if (curN == 0 || curK == 0) continue;
            
            int step = 1 << bitCount[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (twoPowerCount[i] + twoPowerCount[curN - i] == twoPowerCount[curN] && !visited[curN - i][curK - 1]) {
                    visited[curN - i][curK - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{curN - i, curK - 1});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int idx = orderList.size() - 1; idx >= 0; --idx) {
            int[] cur = orderList.get(idx);
            int curN = cur[0], curK = cur[1];
            if (curN == 0) {
                dp[curN][curK] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (curK == 0) {
                dp[curN][curK] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            
            int step = 1 << bitCount[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (twoPowerCount[i] + twoPowerCount[curN - i] == twoPowerCount[curN]) {
                    dp[curN][curK] = (int) ((dp[curN][curK] + (long) binomial(curN, i) * dp[curN - i][curK - 1] % modVal * curK) % modVal);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return dp[startN][startK];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(System.in);
        int[] tempInt = new int[1];
        long[] tempLL = new long[1];

        bitCount[0] = -1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 262150; ++i) {
            fact[i] = (int) (((long) fact[i - 1] * i) % modVal);
            bitCount[i] = bitCount[i >> 1] + 1;
            twoPowerCount[i] = twoPowerCount[i - 1] + countTrailingZeros(i);
        }
        
        invFact[262150] = modPow(fact[262150], (int) (modVal - 2));
        for (int i = 262149; i >= 1; --i) {
            invFact[i] = (int) (((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % modVal);
        }
        
        invFact[0] = invFact[1];
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow((int) k, (int) n));
        } else {
            int ans = modPow((int) k, (int) n);
            int result = iterativeSolve((int) n, (int) k);
            int finalResult = (int) ((ans - result) % modVal);
            if (finalResult < 0) finalResult += modVal;
            System.out.println(finalResult);
        }
    }
